---
name: Reviewer Request
about: Request a new review persona for a domain not yet covered
labels: enhancement
---

## Domain

What area should this reviewer cover? (e.g., security, mobile, DevOps, database schema, accessibility)

## What Would It Catch

List 3–5 concrete things this reviewer would flag that existing reviewers miss.

## Sample Inputs

Paste or describe a representative artifact the reviewer would assess — a skill file, a plan, a code diff.

## Additional Context

Any references to existing reviewers this would complement, or domains it should stay out of.
